preamble: WHEREAS it is expedient to repeal the Bidi (Restriction of Manufacture) Ordinance, 1966 (E.P. Ord. IV of 1966); It is hereby enacted as follows:—

body.text: This Act may be called the Bidi (Restriction of Manufacture) (Repeal) Act, 1974.
It shall come into force at once.
The Bidi (Restriction of Manufacture) Ordinance, 1966 (E.P. Ord. IV of 1966) is hereby repealed.
